parsed.text: This packet reports per-node, per-role discrete location distributions on separate 4x4 local grids. Origins: copied prior records are historical (not new estimates) and conditional command records are hypothetical branches (not executed events). Current (null command) summaries: n0 in both panels shows blue concentrated at cell (0,1) and red at (0,3); n1 and n2 are uniform across their grids for both roles; p0 current n3 concentrates blue at (1,2) and red at (0,1); p1 current n3 is uniform. Candidate (k0/k1/k2) records reproduce the same n0–n2 patterns; n3 varies by panel and command: p0 candidates consistently peak blue at (1,2) and red at (0,1) with peak probabilities near 0.95–0.99; p1 candidates include a uniform branch (k0) and branches with blue peaks on the lower-right quadrant or at (1,2) and corresponding red peaks on (0,1) or the upper-left quadrant. Differences across command-conditioned distributions are reflected above and in the per-distribution peak lists.
